firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg / 390-first.jpg: h1 'Auto repair for the Anchorage car-year' names trade+city, Book a drop-off primary + quieter dash-light secondary, phone in header at 1440 and sticky bar at 390, proof line with Sample rating, -8/34/64 season ledger answers 'why them'. Nav now readable over the night hero; drawn road+headlights hero replaces the broken image. Proof line wraps leaving an orphan middle dot after 'Sample rating' and the license alone on line 2 (-0.5).

distinctiveness.notes: Thermo rail now visible and season-coloured in every mid frame: glacier at -8 (1440-first.jpg), spruce at 34 (1440-scroll-25.jpg), fireweed at 64 (1440-scroll-50.jpg / 1440-scroll-75.jpg); season-filed services and the year curve (1440-rm-full.jpg) carry the car-year idea. Clearly unlike siblings. Mono micro-labels with middle-dot meta strings ('Outside 34°F · April') above every season heading remain a template tell (-0.5).

type.notes: 1440-first.jpg: Bodoni Moda display at real scale contrast, tight tracking; 1440-scroll-50.jpg huge 64° in fireweed is a true type moment; italic Bodoni guarantee and review quote (1440-rm-full.jpg). The hairline minus in Bodoni makes '-8°' read as '8°' in the winter story and services index (1440-rm-full.jpg, 1440-scroll-75.jpg) (-0.5).

layout.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg: tones alternate cleanly (night, glacier, spruce, white, night, paper, white, steel, grey, white, night) and season stories now differ in shape. Winter numeral '8' sits on top of the 'Outside -8°F' kicker, cutting it to 'utside' (1440-rm-full.jpg) (-0.5). Breakup band right third empty under the 34° for ~500px (1440-scroll-25.jpg) (-0.5); decoder is a plain 2x2 card grid (1440-rm-full.jpg) offset by the season spreads.

photo.notes: Stock replaced by drawn scenes: night road with headlights (1440-first.jpg), plugged-in car at -8 (1440-rm-full.jpg), frost-heave road with wheel (1440-scroll-25.jpg), Denali road with fireweed (1440-scroll-50.jpg). One coherent flat palette tied to each season, nothing broken. Drawings are simple flat clip-art level (car front is a box with lamps), no texture or grain, so they read as placeholders rather than art direction (-1.0); credit line 'Illustrations drawn for this page' present (1440-rm-full.jpg).

copy.notes: 1440-scroll-50.jpg 'Before Seward, Denali or the Haul Road'; 1440-rm-full.jpg 'Breakup bends what winter loosened', 'We show you what we found before we fix anything', concrete decoder verdicts ('Safe to drive in. Book this week.'). Sample labels on rating, pricing, reviews; form thanks says 'In the live version'. Arrow on every 'Price it →' / 'Call the shop →' link is a small tell, kept from scoring 9.5.
